subject: MAP milestone: Load test coordination & capacity-sizing confirmation
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <ops@skylineretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP milestone: Load test coordination & capacity-sizing confirmation

Alex — thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the MAP milestone focused on the load/perf validation so we can agree on timing and responsibilities:

Summary of objective:
- Run a traffic-replay load test that mimics peak retail traffic (site checkout + API tokens) to validate latency and autoscaling behavior before go-live.

Proposed test window:
- Primary run: Thu, Nov 4 2026 00:00–04:00 PT (low customer impact window)
- Dry run: Wed, Oct 27 2026 23:00–00:30 PT (sanity check)

Key stats requested from you (please confirm by EOD Tue 10/21):
- Peak QPS (aggregate): suggested: 12,000 rps (please confirm)
- Percent of requests that hit model generation path vs. cache: estimated 60% gen / 40% cache
- Any PII in trace payloads (yes/no) — if yes, we need sanitized replay dataset

Responsibilities (MAP draft, milestone 'Load validation'):
- Skyline Retail: provide sanitized traffic replay file (or give safe-sampling rules) and confirm peak QPS target — due Tue 10/21
- Redwood Inference (Marissa/Dylan): provision dedicated capacity, produce capacity-sizing calc and run dry run — due Fri 10/30
- Redwood SRE (Grace): run orchestration and monitor KPIs, collect traces and token-level cost breakdown during run
- Both parties: post-test retrospective and decision gate for production cutover within 5 business days after primary run

Dependencies / blockers:
- Data sanitization for replay (customer action)
- Confirmed SOW amendment for dedicated burst capacity (DocuSign link in related links)

Attachments: MAP-draft-Skyline-20261020.pdf (MAP - milestone details), replay-config-v1.json (template), capacity-sizing-sheet.xlsx (calcs)

Ask: Can you confirm the three data points above and sign off on the dry-run window? If any date conflicts, propose alternatives.

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa on sizing and Dylan on orchestration once we have your numbers.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee

On Tue, 20 Oct 2026 at 09:12, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the MAP milestone focused on the load/perf validation so we can agree on timing and responsibilities:

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers: 
- Peak QPS: our observed peak last holiday spike was ~14,500 rps. For initial test, let's aim for 10,500 rps (75% of peak) to be conservative.
- Gen vs cache split: our telemetry looks closer to 65% gen / 35% cache for checkout flows.
- PII: there is customer email and masked payment IDs in traces — we will provide a sanitized export by EOD Wed 10/21.

We also want a point-of-contact on Redwood side for SRE during the dry run (pager/contact). Jordan Li (platform owner) will be on our side for orchestration.

We agree to the proposed dry run window 10/27 and primary run 11/4. Please confirm capacity sizing and if any additional prerequisites (certificate rotations, IP allowlist) are needed.

— Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of Platform Operations | Skyline Retail
ops@skylineretail.com | +1 (206) 555-3389
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <ops@skylineretail.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP milestone: Load test coordination & capacity-sizing confirmation

Alex — thanks for the numbers and for committing to sanitized data. Short note from the engineering side on sizing and ops plan:

Capacity plan (preliminary):
- We'll reserve a dedicated pool equivalent to 8x A100-80GB instances for the primary run. Based on Skyline's 10.5k rps target and your gen/cache split, our estimate is this will meet the latency SLO (95th ~ <450ms) with headroom for autoscaling to add 2 nodes if sustained above target. Detailed calcs are in capacity-sizing-sheet.xlsx.

Traffic replay guidance:
- For dry run (10/27) we will run at 50% of the target QPS (5.25k rps) to validate orchestration and replay correctness.
- For the primary run (11/4) we will start ramping from 50% to target over the first 30 minutes, then hold for 2 hours, then run a short spike test at 120% of target for 10 minutes.

Operational prerequisites:
- IP allowlist: provide the egress IPs for our test agents by Mon 10/26 (we will send list)
- VPN / certs: if you're using an internal-only endpoint, please confirm access or provide a secure replay endpoint
- Contact: Redwood SRE on-call for both runs will be Grace O'Connor (pager: +1 (415) 555-0177, grace.sre@redwood.ai)

Action items and owners (MAP milestone):
- Skyline: sanitized replay file + IP allowlist (Alex/Jordan) — due Wed 10/21 (sanitized file) and Mon 10/26 (IP allowlist)
- Redwood: provision pool + dry-run orchestration (Marissa/Dylan) — dry run ready by Tue 10/26 end-of-day
- Redwood SRE: runbook and monitoring dashboard link provided to Skyline by Tue 10/26

I will also seed the HubSpot MAP with these milestones (link in related links). Once the dry run completes we will do a 60-minute retrospective and decide on production rollout timing.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0191
From: Jordan Li <platform@skylineretail.com>

Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP milestone: Load test coordination & capacity-sizing confirmation

Thanks Marissa — Jordan here (platform). Confirmed on our side: sanitized replay file uploaded to the secure bucket (link shared in separate channel), IP allowlist request will be submitted by EOD Mon 10/26.

We'd like to add a short dry-run checklist item: verify token-scoped rate limits so our downstream CDNs don't misclassify replay traffic. If Redwood can publish expected agent UA/IP header we'll stamp that into the replay agent. Also requesting a 30-minute dry-run prep call 10/27 at 22:15 PT to walk through the runbook.

— Jordan
Jordan Li

Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP milestone: Load test coordination & capacity-sizing confirmation

Great — thanks all for the confirmations. Final checklist and next steps from Redwood: 

1) Dry-run prep call: Wed 10/27 22:15 PT — invite will be sent by calendar.
2) Dry run: Wed 10/27 23:00–00:30 PT at 50% QPS (5.25k) — Redwood to collect traces and share preliminary report within 8 business hours.
3) Primary run: Thu 11/4 00:00–04:00 PT — ramp to 10.5k rps, spike to 12.6k (120%) for 10m.
4) SOW amendment & Sizing confirmation: DocuSign link sent (related links) — please sign by Fri 10/24 so we can lock in the reserved pool.

Assigned owners:
- Soojin (account lead): coordinate sign-off and executive communication
- Marissa (solutions): sizing and dry-run orchestration
- Dylan (platform): replay ingestion pipeline and instrumentation
- Grace (SRE): run execution and RCA artifacts
- Alex/Jordan (Skyline): sanitized replay + IP allowlist + on-call for customer's side

If anyone needs to shift windows or adjust capacity we can re-evaluate, but signing the SOW by 10/24 keeps us on track for a Nov cutover decision.

Thanks — will send calendar invites and attach the final MAP milestone PDF after the SOW is signed.

— Soojin
